from: June book, night 19 (David Was Kind to Saul)
p1: King Saul was upset that the people loved David. Saul wanted to hurt him, so David and his men hid.
Saul brought soldiers to look for David. One day Saul went into a cave. He did not know David was hiding inside!
David’s men whispered, “Now is your chance!” David quietly cut a little piece from Saul’s robe. Then he said, “I will not hurt the king the Lord chose.”
p2: Outside, David called, “Look at this piece of your robe! I did not hurt you.” Saul cried and said, “You were good to me.” Another night, David found Saul asleep. Again, David did not hurt him.
Being kind when someone is unkind is very brave. Tonight, ask Heavenly Father to help you be kind.
old: King Saul was still angry. He chased David with his soldiers! David and his men hid in a big dark cave. Then something amazing happened.
King Saul came RIGHT into the same cave! He didn’t see David in the dark. David’s men whispered, “Now you can hurt him! He’ll never know!”
But David said, “No! He is the king. I won’t hurt him.” David quietly snuck up and cut just a tiny piece off Saul’s robe.
When Saul left the cave, David called out, “King Saul! See? I could have hurt you, but I didn’t!” Saul cried and said, “You are kinder than I am!” David chose kindness over revenge.
